notes: A hand-written fake model output, not a real writer's: replace it with a live run's (--import-live). The opening rightly holds the fee back until the parent is confirmed.

script.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, this is Lakshmi from Bright Minds Coaching. Am I speaking to the parent?

stages.name: Confirm the parent
stages.instruction: Confirm you are speaking to the parent before saying anything about the fee.

scripts.en-IN: I am calling about your child's classes. Is this a good time?

stages.name: Due date
stages.instruction: Remind them the second term fee is due on 10 December and that they can pay at the office or by UPI. Ask the payment status.

scripts.en-IN: The second term fee is due on the tenth of December. You can pay at the office or by UPI.

stages.name: When they pay
stages.instruction: Ask when they plan to pay. If they have a problem paying, offer to put them through to the office manager.

scripts.en-IN: When do you plan to pay it?

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Thank them and end the call.

step_outcomes.outcome: It is confirmed the person is the parent.
The parent knows the due date and how to pay.
The parent gives a date they will pay.
